description: Function generator running as a one-shot envelope, a free-running LFO or an audio oscillator, with the wave adjustable in curvature, rise-to-fall balance and harmonic content

params.text: Advances the generator mode on each press: cyclic after a one-shot AD envelope, a one-shot AR envelope after cyclic, then AD again; with the Sheep model chosen the press changes wave bank instead
Advances the frequency range on each press: high after medium, low after high, then medium again
Chooses between the tidal modulator and the Sheep wavetable synthesizer; the display beside it shows T or S, or P while the peacocks plotter is on
Sets the rate, four octaves either side of centre; while clock sync is on it sets the ratio between the clock and the output instead
Attenuverts the FM input, 5V shifting the pitch by an octave at full clockwise; with nothing patched to FM that input reads 0.1V, so the knob works as a fine frequency control
Sets the curvature of the rising and falling segments; with the Sheep model chosen it sets the X coordinate in the wave map
Sets the split between rise and fall: fully counter-clockwise the rise is instant, fully clockwise the fall is; with the Sheep model it sets the Y coordinate in the wave map
Low-pass filters the wave counter-clockwise of noon and wavefolds it clockwise of noon
Locks the generator to the CLOCK input while it is on; with the tidal modulator model a cable patched to CLOCK turns the lock on without this button

inputs.text: Adds to the SHAPE knob, 5V covering the whole knob range
Adds to the SLOPE knob, 5V covering the whole knob range
Adds to the SMOOTH knob, 5V covering the whole knob range
A voltage of 0.7V or more starts the envelope in AD or AR mode, and resets the phase in cyclic mode
A voltage of 0.7V or more stops the wave where it is until the voltage falls again
Sets the rate, one volt per octave
Shifts the rate through the FM attenuverter; with nothing patched it reads a constant 0.1V
Scales the UNI and BI outputs like a VCA, 8V giving full level and higher voltages clipped; with nothing patched it reads 8V

Locks the generator to this signal whenever a cable is patched here with the tidal modulator model chosen, reading high at 0.7V; with the Sheep model and clock sync off, pulses here step the wave bank

outputs.text: Carries 5V once the rising segment has finished and returns to 0V when the cycle restarts or a new trigger arrives; with the Sheep model chosen it carries a one-bit version of the wave
Carries 5V once the falling segment has finished; with the Sheep model chosen it carries a square sub-oscillator an octave down
The wave as a unipolar signal, 0-8V
The wave as a bipolar signal, -5V to 5V, with a positive and a negative bump in each cycle rather than a shifted copy of the unipolar wave

notes: the module is monophonic: every jack reads or writes a single channel.
the peacocks plotter, switched on from the right-click menu, disables every control and drives the UNI and BI outputs with the X and Y of a drawing, for a scope in X-Y mode.
menu: Model: Tidal Modulator, Sheep - Wavetable synthesizer — chooses the model the module runs
Mode: AD Envelope, Cyclic, AR Envelope — sets what the generator does, and appears only with the tidal modulator model
Wave table: Additive harmonics, PWMish, Nodi WMAP — picks the bank of waves the Sheep model scans, and appears only with that model
Range: High, Medium, Low — sets the frequency range
Compatibility options — the submenu holding the settings that restore how older versions of the module behaved
Frequency knob center is C4 — subtracts a volt from the pitch so a centred FREQUENCY knob gives C4; switching it off restores the older tuning. It is on the Compatibility options submenu
Peacocks easter egg — switches the plotter on and off
